meta.title: Blood Bank Serology Market – Executive View
meta.subtitle: Strategic synthesis for transfusion diagnostics suppliers: where value sits and how to position for 2033

slides.title: Executive view: a USD 3.3 Bn market growing at 7.45%, where competition is shifting from reagents to complete workflows
slides.source: Grand View Research, Blood Bank Serology Market Analysis and Segment Forecast to 2033 (2026)

rows.text: The market grows from USD 3,329.3 Mn in 2025 to USD 5,893.1 Mn by 2033 (7.45% CAGR). Demand rests on continuous blood collection, routine compatibility testing and mandatory infectious-marker screening, so suppliers compete on automation, connectivity, QC and reliable reagent supply.

items.title: Immunohematology – Value Anchor
items.text: 61.8% share; RBC phenotyping and ABO & Rh grouping lead.
**Now:** hospital transfusion labs (42.5%), automated grouping and screening
**Next:** plasma fractionation labs (8.09% CAGR), qualification assays
**Build:** reference labs, reagents for anti-CD38 interference

rows.label: Consultant implication
rows.text: Position as a workflow partner: pair analyzers with assured reagent supply, LIS connectivity and service, and lead with donor-screening and plasma-qualification assays where growth is fastest.

slides.title: Segment Summary & Positioning
slides.subtitle: Gel automation and immunoassay drive technology growth; plasma fractionation drives end-use growth
slides.source: Grand View Research, Blood Bank Serology Market Analysis and Segment Forecast to 2033 (2026)

cols.label: Analyst insights
items: **Immunoassay (30.5%)** leads on TTI screening via CLIA/CMIA, ECLIA and ELISA.
**Column agglutination / gel (8.28% CAGR)** is the fastest-growing technology.
**Plasma fractionation labs** rise from 17.4% to 18.3% share by 2033.
**Hospital-based labs** add USD 1,084.4 Mn, the largest end-use gain.

slides.title: Summarized Regional Insights
slides.subtitle: North America anchors value; Asia Pacific drives growth at the fastest pace
slides.source: Grand View Research, Blood Bank Serology Market Analysis and Segment Forecast to 2033 (2026); CAGR 2025–2033 is GVR analysis

cols.label: Analyst insights
items: **North America (41.3%)**: U.S. holds 83.85% of the region; mature networks and automation.
**Asia Pacific (28.5%)**: fastest CAGR of 8.08%; reaches USD 1,761.6 Mn by 2033.
**Europe (24.7%)**: Germany 22.81% of region; EU IVDR raises documentation burden.
